description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

description.zh: DNS服务器列表（仅供DNS域名服务使用）
description.en: The list of Domain Name System (DNS) servers (for DNS domain name services only).
The unique ID of the gateway.

description.zh: 服务地址列表（固定地址服务）/ 域名列表（DNS域名服务）
description.en: The address list of fixed address services or domain name list of Domain Name System (DNS) services.

description.zh: 服务名称（已废弃，不支持修改，调用时需要和当前服务名称保持一致）。
description.en: The service name. This parameter is deprecated and cannot be modified. The value of this parameter must be the same as the current service name.

description.zh: 服务端口（DNS域名服务填写）。
description.en: The service port. Specify this parameter for DNS services.

description.zh:
TLS设定。

- TLS模式：mode

- 证书ID：certId

- CA证书ID：caCertId

- CA证书公钥：caCertContent

- 服务名称标识：sni
description.en:
The Transport Layer Security (TLS) settings. Valid values:

- mode: TLS mode

- certId: certificate ID

- caCertId: CA certificate ID

- caCertContent: CA certificate public key

- sni: service name identification

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-service --id 322 --gateway-id 501 --name test --ip-list 192.168.1.1:80 --service-port 80 --service-protocol HTTP --gateway-unique-id gw-c9bc5afd61014165bd58f621b49100000 --tls-setting mode_:_MUTUAL_,_certId_:_100000-cn-hangzhou_,_caCertContent_:_123_,_sni_:_ceshi --dns-server-list 1.1.1.1:80 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
